about: Truncate clips text to a number of lines with an ellipsis, and shows the whole text in a tooltip only while something is cut off. The text is measured, so the tooltip goes away when the box grows. A clamp clips the paint and not the document, so a screen reader reads the whole text once.

description.text: Barge NL-2291 left Rotterdam Maasvlakte II at 04:15 for Duisburg Ruhrort. At Emmerich am Rhein a customs count found two seals broken and one container declared for a consignee that closed in March, so the load goes back down the Rhine to the terminal that loaded it.

fits.about: The same component around text that fits: no tooltip, no tab stop and no mark, because a tooltip that repeats text already on the page adds nothing.
fits.name: Duisburg Ruhrort
fits.title: Text that fits

lines.about: One description at 1, 2 and 3 lines in one narrow room. Every one of them clips, so every one shows the whole text in a tooltip under the pointer.
lines.title: Lines

notes.about: A clipped note takes a tab stop because focusable is set, and keyboard focus opens its tooltip. The delivered note fits, so Tab skips it.

items.held: Held at Emmerich am Rhein for a customs count that found two seals broken on the upper tier
items.rerouted: Rerouted through Nijmegen after the lock at Weurt closed for repairs until Thursday morning

notes.title: Reachable by keyboard

shipment.about: Clipped text on a row beside a badge that does not shrink. The text takes the room the badge leaves and clips there, in place of pushing the badge off the row.
shipment.note: Barge NL-2291 held at Emmerich am Rhein for a customs count after two seals were found broken on the upper tier
shipment.title: Beside something fixed
